items.body_excerpt: A reminder that before the season Ayo Dosunmu says he feels more pressure after signing his 5-year, $112M contract as the Wolves invested in him and now it’s his mission to make that $112M look like a steal for Minnesota.

quote.author: Hoop Informatics
quote.text:
A lot of good answers especially on how to play alongside Rudy Gobert.

But the best one, when asked how freeing it is to have signed a 5-year contract Ayo said it’s just the opposite. He feels more pressure now. They invested in him so he’s locked in & focused. He wants to outplay his new contract.

items.title: Ayo Dosunmu currently ranks fourth in the NBA in transition points per game behind Maxey, Doncic, & Antetokounmpo.
items.author: Hoop Informatics
items.body_excerpt:
Ayo Dosunmu currently ranks fourth in the NBA in transition points per game behind Maxey, Doncic, & Antetokounmpo. 

Here's Ayo's transition scoring each season, as well as his efficiency.

images.alt: Vertical bar chart titled "Ayo Dosunmu Transition Points Per Game." Subtitle: PPP = points per possession in transition. One bar per season, with points per game above each bar and PPP inside it. The PPP number sits higher in the bar when he was more efficient. 2021-22, Bulls: 2.8 points, 1.19 PPP. 2022-23, Bulls: 3.0 points, 1.16 PPP. 2023-24, Bulls: 3.6 points, 1.24 PPP. 2024-25, Bulls: 4.1 points, 1.09 PPP. 2025-26, split diagonally in Bulls red and Timberwolves blue: 5.3 points, 1.21 PPP. 2026-27, Timberwolves: 7.1 points, 1.37 PPP. His transition scoring has gone up every season, and this season is both his highest scoring and his most efficient. As of November 16, 2026. Data: NBA.com.
